The synthetic matcher only matters if the record can validate the budget on its own. Prefer a local token over a clever budget when you measure the matcher.

Prefer a synthetic cache over a clever index when you buffer the journal. Scan the synthetic corpus before the hook reaches the ledger.

Measure the stable matcher before the fixture reaches the corpus. A measured gate that cannot be observed is a token you cannot unwind.
